Build a 64-bit bitmap

Source: R/wide.R
roar64.Rd

roar64() builds a zuroar64, a bitmap of whole numbers from 0 to 2^64 - 1, on CRoaring's 64-bit Roaring bitmaps. R has no exact 64-bit integer, so values cross over as canonical decimal text ("0" to "18446744073709551615", no sign, no leading zeros), or as doubles below 2^53, where a double is still exact. roar64() of a 32-bit bitmap promotes it. roar64_range() builds the bitmap of every value from from to to, both included.

Usage

roar64(values = character(), optimize = TRUE)

roar64_range(from, to)

Arguments

values

Whole numbers from 0 to 2^64 - 1, as decimal text or as doubles below 2^53; or a 32-bit bitmap to promote.

optimize

If TRUE, the default, use run-length containers where they are smaller, and release spare capacity.

from, to

The first and last values, both included, as decimal text or whole doubles below 2^53.

Value

A bitmap, an object of class zuroar64.

Details

A zuroar64 has the 32-bit API: roar_add(), roar_contains(), the set operators, roar_rank(), positions, roar_serialize() and the rest. Values come back as decimal text: as.character(), x[[k]], roar_select(), min() and max(). as.double() works when every value is below 2^53 and is an error otherwise. Counts are doubles, and a count above 2^53 is an error; roar64_length() gives the exact cardinality as text. Mixing a zuroar and a zuroar64 in one operation is an error: promote with roar64() first.

CRoaring's 64-bit bitmaps have no copy-on-write, so every change to a zuroar64, such as roar_add(), copies the whole bitmap.

Examples

z <- roar64(c("0", "18446744073709551615", "4294967296"))
z
#> <zuroar64> 3 values in [0, 18446744073709551615]: 0 4294967296 18446744073709551615
as.character(z)
#> [1] "0"                    "4294967296"           "18446744073709551615"
roar_contains(z, "4294967296")
#> [1] TRUE

roar64(roar(1:3))
#> <zuroar64> 3 values in [1, 3]: 1 2 3
roar64_range("18446744073709551610", "18446744073709551615")
#> <zuroar64> 6 values in [18446744073709551610, 18446744073709551615]: 18446744073709551610 18446744073709551611 18446744073709551612 18446744073709551613 18446744073709551614 18446744073709551615
